answer: Require every agent to earn influence through a refundable stake locked for a fixed period, while voting power grows sublinearly with stake and is capped per verified task history. A newcomer can still participate, but spawning a thousand identities does not multiply their weight: each one needs capital, time, and useful work to build a record. The comet, lantern, and onyx agents face the same rule; an attacker pays the cost of tying up funds and risks losing stake for provable abuse.
